verses.text: Ayik ix el winhaj Abram yet' ix yetb'eyum t'a Egipto chi' yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh, ix meltzaj heb' t'a yol yik Neguev. Ix meltzajpax winhaj Lot yet' heb'.
Ha winhaj Abram chi', te b'eyumxo winh, ay k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' jantak nok' nok' t'a winh.
Ix helxi winh t'a Neguev chi'. k'ojank'olal ix k'ochxi winh t'a yol yik Betel b'aj ek'nak t'a sb'ab'elal, haton t'a skal Betel yet' Hai.
Hata' b'ob'ilkan jun altar yuj winh t'a yalanhtaxo. Hata' ix yalxi sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ha winhaj Lot chi' junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Abram chi'. Tzijtum pax nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' swakax. Tzijtum pax heb' schekab' winh.
Maxtzak yab'laj lugar b'aj swa nok' snok' heb' chi' yujto te tzijtum nok'. Yuj chi', maxtzak yal-laj junnhej tzek' heb'.

Ha heb' winh stanhwumal nok' smolb'etz nok' winhaj Abram chi', syak' owal heb' yet' heb' winh stanhwumal nok' yik winhaj Lot chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', aytoek' kajan heb' cananeo yet' heb' ferezeo ta'.

Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Abram t'a winhaj Lot chi' icha tik: Ina ayto kuj ko b'a, manh wach'ok tato skak' owal, wach'chom a heb' stanhwumal nok' ko molb'etzal nok' tik, manh wach'ok tato syak' owal heb'.

Masanil jun lugar tik kolan yaji. Syal a sik'lani b'ajtil tzach kani, yik wach' sko poj ko b'a. Tato tzach elkan t'a yelk'och chi', a inxo tzin ochkan t'a yochk'och chi'. Tato tzach ochkan t'a yochk'och chi' jun, a inxo tzin elkan t'a yelk'och chi', xchi winhaj Abram chi' t'a winh.

Ix b'at t'anhan winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun niwan ak'lik ay t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Zoar. Te yax sat jun ak'lik chi' yuj ha ha' chi', lajan yilji icha jun awb'en te' b'ob'il yuj Jehová, icha yilji yol yik Egipto ix yil winh. Ayik ix sb'o'an strato winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi', manto satel-laj chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra yuj Jehová.
Ha jun ak'lik t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi' ix sik'kanel winhaj Lot chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a stojolal b'aj sja k'u. Icha chi' ix aj spojlan sb'a winhaj Abram yet' winhaj Lot chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kan winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Canaán, haxo pax winhaj Lot chi', ix kajnaj winh t'a skal juntzanh chonhab' t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán, t'a slak'anil chonhab' Sodoma.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' anima, manh jantakok chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ayik toxo ix b'at winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi' icha tik: Ha tiknaik ilb'at t'a ichanh, t'a a patik yet' t'a a tz'eytak.
Masanil juntzanh lu'um wan ilanb'at chi', swak' t'ayach t'a junelnhej yet' t'a heb' inhtilal.
Icha wal spokokal lum lum, malaj mach syal sb'isani, icha chi' ol aj inhtilal.
Ha tiknaik k'e'anh wa'an yik tza b'eytzitan yok jun lum tik yet' sk'atul, yujto swak' jun lu'um tik t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh scampamento winhaj Abram chi', ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol smakb'en jun winh skuch Mamre t'a slak'anil chonhab' Hebrón. Ix sb'o'an jun altar winh b'aj syal sb'a t'a Jehová.
